jobDescription: We are looking for the next Rocket Singh who has what it takes to be the 'salesman of the year'. title: Training & Development - Internship
jobDescription: Selected intern's day-to-day responsibilities include: 1. Assist in developing and customizing student resumes in alignment with specific job descriptions and recruiter expectations. 2. Ensure resumes are well-structured, error-free, and submission-ready. 3. Maintain accurate trackers for resume requests, timelines, and completion status. 4. Provide timely support for urgent resume alignment requests from the Placement team. 5. Assist in basic communication and articulation improvement through content review and feedback. 6. Coordinate effectively with Career Prep and Placement teams to ensure smooth execution of requirements. 7. Adhere to defined quality standards and turnaround timelines.

title: Business Development (Sales) - Internship
jobDescription: Selected intern's day-to-day responsibilities include: 1. Connect with training & placement officers and students through calls, emails, and messaging to promote exclusive campaigns, fostering college participation and driving registrations/job application. 2. Support colleges in the registration process by providing essential materials and motivating institutions to actively promote the initiative among their students. 3. Conduct systematic follow-ups with students and colleges to ensure timely registrations and applications, addressing inquiries and offering assistance throughout the campaign. 4. Crawl, compile, and maintain comprehensive databases of training and placement officers and colleges, enabling efficient communication and tracking outreach effectiveness. 5. Create engaging marketing materials to boost campaign visibility and monitor daily progress on registrations, generating analytical reports that highlight outreach efforts, response rates, and areas for improvement.

title: Marketing Designer Associate - Fresher
jobDescription: Key Responsibilities: 1. Design landing pages, ad creatives, emailers, and WhatsApp templates for the company's offerings from concept to execution. 2. Build modular, variable-driven templates that enable personalized creatives based on users' stream, applied roles, city, and activity. 3. Use AI tools to generate high volumes of copy, design, and layout variations, then evaluate and finalize the most effective creatives. 4. Run experiments by forming hypotheses, designing creative variants, analyzing results, and iterating based on performance. 5. Write sharp, conversion-focused copy tailored to a 17-24-year-old audience.
